title: PosMerchantBatchOperationStatus

batch_id.description: A value that identifies a batch of merchant operation requests.

processing_complete.description: True if all requests in this batch have been processed (successful or not), false otherwise.

additionalProperties.description: Deprecated - will be replaced by merchant_statuses array. Associations of merchant IDs and their processing status.

merchant_status.description: Deprecated - will be replaced by merchant_statuses array. Associations of merchant IDs and their processing status.

merchant_statuses.description: List containing the processing status for each merchant ID, including additional information in case of a NOT_FOUND / INVALID status.

description: Describes the state (completed or not) of an entire batch of merchant operation requests together with the status of each individual request associated to this batch.

merchant_id.description: The Grubhub(internal) or Partner(external) merchant ID.

status.description: Status of the bulk processing operation, one of SUCCESSFUL, NOT_FOUND, INVALID, FAILED, FAILED_TO_QUEUE, IN_PROGRESS, REQUESTED.

details.description: Additional details present in case of a NOT_FOUND / INVALID status.

MerchantStatus.description: Merchant ID and their bulk processing status, including additional information in case of NOT_FOUND / INVALID statuses.
